title: Dreaming — nightly memory consolidation
description: A composite loop that runs during low-activity hours to consolidate daily memories, extract learnings, and prune stale ones. The agent's 'sleep' cycle.
prompt: Consolidate the last 24 hours of conversation history. Extract new learnings and store them. Apply decay scoring to older memories. Flag any that fall below the removal threshold. Produce a summary of what was consolidated.
